messages.text: Good morning, I'm a backpacker from the UK looking for somewhere to settle in Brisbane. I love what I've seen of the city and would like to set some roots down before I head home in July. I recently got a job in fortitude valley so spring Hill is perfect for me! I'm very tidy, active and Social. I hope you feel I'm a good fit for your lovely house

Hi Amy,
Thanks for reaching out. Would you like to come tonight at 18:45 for the inspection?
40 Rosa St, Spring Hill QLD 4000
Emilio will be there to assist you.
+61 481 517 377 (WhatsApp)
